caption: The drawing depicts a detailed side profile view of a rooster, rendered entirely in shades of gray. The rooster features a prominently arched and textured tail, a clearly defined comb on its head, and intricate feather patterns covering its body, wing, and tail. Its beak is closed, and the bird’s eye is shown in profile. The rooster stands on a short vertical rod that extends downward from the underside of its body. The illustration is centered within a rectangular border, and there is a small linear scale at the bottom left corner of the page. The artist's name, "GRUBSTEIN," appears in the lower right corner, inside the border. The background is plain, unshaded, and the drawing is executed with fine lines and gradients to show surface texture and depth.
title: Weather Vane Finial
